% A document written for pdflatex that calls the pdfTeX primitives that are
% an error in DVI mode, where tex4ht's latex runs. In the PDF each one
% writes into the PDF and puts nothing on the page, except the image, the
% form, and the colors. On the page the text around each one stays, and
% none of their arguments shows. They come in the preamble, in the body, in
% a macro, in italic, sans-serif, and typewriter text, in a footnote, a
% theorem, a box, a heading written to the table of contents, and in the
% document's own package. The primitives that only warn in DVI mode stay
% primitives.
\pdfoutput=1
\pdfmapline{=before-class.pfb}
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\usepackage{cmap}
\usepackage{test-pdfprim}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\pdfmapfile{+foo.map}
\pdfmapline{=bar.pfb}
\input glyphtounicode
\pdfgentounicode=1
\pdfcompresslevel=9
\pdfminorversion=5
\pdfinfo{/Title (A title)}
\pdfcatalog{/PageMode /UseNone}
\pdftrailer{/Info 1 0 R}
\pdfpageattr{/Rotate 0}
\pdfpagesattr{/Rotate 0}
\pdfpageresources{/Foo 1}
\pdfglyphtounicode{alpha}{03B1}
\pdfnames{/Foo [1 2]}
\pdfobj{<< /Preamble 1 >>}
\pdffontattr\font{/Foo 1}
\pdfincludechars\font{abc}
\pdfnobuiltintounicode\font
\let\mylit\pdfliteral
\newcommand\blue[1]{\pdfliteral{0 0 1 rg}#1\pdfliteral{0 g}}
\makeatletter
\newcommand\isprim[1]{\begingroup\edef\a{\meaning#1}\edef\b{\string#1}%
  \expandafter\@gobble\string#1~\ifx\a\b primitive\else redefined\fi\endgroup}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents

\section{Head \pdfliteral direct{0 0 1 rg}x\pdfliteral page{0 g}
  \pdfsave\pdfsetmatrix{1 0 0 1}\pdfrestore y \blue{z}
  \pdfcolorstack0 push{0 0 1 rg}w\pdfcolorstack0 pop}

Literal: before\pdfliteral{0 0 1 rg} blue\pdfliteral direct{0 g}
\pdfliteral page{0 g}after.

Let: before\mylit{0 g} after.

Macro: before \blue{one} after.

Math: before $a\blue{b}c$ after.

Italic: \emph{before \blue{two}\pdfliteral{0 g} after}.

Sans: \textsf{before \blue{three}\pdfliteral direct{0 g} after}.

Typewriter: \texttt{before \blue{four}\pdfliteral page{0 g} after}.

Package: before \pkgblue{five} after.

Footnote: before\footnote{Note \blue{six}\pdfliteral direct{0 g} end.} after.

\begin{theorem}
Theorem \blue{seven}\pdfliteral{0 g} end.
\end{theorem}

Box: \sbox0{\pdfliteral{0 g}boxed}\usebox0{} after.

Image: before\pdfximage width 1cm {test-picture.png}\pdfrefximage\pdflastximage{} after.

Image keywords: before\immediate\pdfximage height 1cm depth 0pt attr{/Foo 1}
page 1 {test-picture.png}\relax{} after.

Objects: before\pdfobj reserveobjnum\xdef\myobj{\the\pdflastobj}%
\immediate\pdfobj useobjnum\myobj{<< /X 1 >>}\pdfrefobj\myobj{} after.
Number: \ifnum\myobj>0 set\else unset\fi.

Stream: before\immediate\pdfobj stream attr{/Y 2}{q Q}\pdfrefobj\pdflastobj{} after.

Form: \setbox2\hbox{form}%
before\pdfxform attr{/X 1} resources{/Y 2} 2\pdfrefxform\pdflastxform{} after.

Matrix: before \pdfsave\pdfsetmatrix{0 1 -1 0}\rlap{turned}\pdfrestore\phantom{turned}{} after.

Stack: before\pdfcolorstack0 push{0 0 1 rg}pushed\pdfcolorstack0 pop{} and
\pdfcolorstack0 set{0 g}set\pdfcolorstack0 current{} after.

Link: before\pdfstartlink height 1em attr{/Border [0 0 0]} user{/Subtype /Link
/A << /S /URI /URI (https://example.com/) >>}linked\pdfrunninglinkoff\pdfrunninglinkon\pdfendlink{} after.

Goto: before\pdfstartlink goto name{here}to here\pdfendlink{} after.

Destination: before\pdfdest name{here} fit after.

Number destination: before\pdfdest num 7 xyz after.

Annotation: before\pdfannot width 1cm height 1em depth 0pt {/Subtype /Text
/Contents (A note)} after.

Outline: before\pdfoutline goto name{here} count 0 {Outline title} after.

Thread: before\pdfthread width 1cm attr{/I << /Title (T) >>} name{t} after.

Snap: before\pdfsnaprefpoint\pdfsnapy 1pt\pdfsnapycomp 500 after.

Spaces: before\pdfspacefont{cmr10}\pdfinterwordspaceon\pdffakespace\pdfinterwordspaceoff{} after.

\pdfstartthread name{u}
Started thread.\par
\pdfendthread

Guards: \isprim\pdfinfo, \isprim\pdfcatalog, \isprim\pdftrailer,
\isprim\pdftrailerid, \isprim\pdfpageattr, \isprim\pdfpagesattr,
\isprim\pdfpageresources, \isprim\pdfcompresslevel, \isprim\pdfminorversion,
\isprim\pdfgentounicode, \isprim\pdfglyphtounicode, \isprim\pdfcolorstackinit.

\end{document}
